verdict.rationale: Restate documents an Admin API endpoint that returns a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec for each registered service, covering all handlers and their request/response schemas. The story is about Restate itself providing a downloadable spec, and that is only partly covered: the spec is generated per user-deployed service. No evidence shows a published spec for Restate's own Admin/ingress API, and the probe found no OpenAPI file at the common docs paths. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec for Restate's own platform/Admin API, a discoverable static download location, independent or hands-on corroboration of the per-service endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the service, describing all handlers and their request/response schemas.
